title: Unichain ImmutableProxy family (~130 clones) = Eco intent Vault escrow; empty + portal-gated
closed_reasons: All 299 named ImmutableProxy clones hold 0 USDC and 0 native (eth_call/eth_getBalance via 4 RPCs, block 62191907)
withdraw/refund/recover/fundFor are onlyPortal on all 3 impls -> NotPortalCaller(0x407c71ac) for a stranger (live probe + fork test)
Vault.portal is an immutable = impl deployer; no initializer / no unguarded setter
Portal value paths are hash-bound: withdraw -> prover-recorded claimant; refund/recoverToken -> reward.creator; refundTo -> creator-only
Changing any reward field (e.g. prover) changes intentHash -> a different empty vault (no redirect)
Every funded intent was withdrawn or refunded: IntentFunded minus (Withdrawn u Refunded) = 0 for both ImmutableProxy-creating portals
Recon's ~$130k is a stale Blockscout /token-balances artifact (stale index sum $271,684.77 vs live $0)

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from the Unichain ImmutableProxy family: all 299 Eco intent-escrow clones are empty and every value path is onlyPortal + hash-bound; the recon's ~$130k is a stale Blockscout token-balances artifact.
